resources.name: NASA POWER
resources.summary: Retrieve meteorological and radiation time series by coordinates, including ICASA output for the agroclimatology community.

coverage.temporal: Daily data from 1981; hourly start dates vary by parameter

access.note: Public queries require no account; observe request-rate and parameter-count limits.

license.name: NASA data use and citation policies
license.note: Cite POWER and the underlying sources; consult the official catalog for individual parameters.

caveats: Point queries represent grid cells rather than local weather-station measurements.
ICASA output can support DSSAT; check units, day boundaries and missing values when adapting it for other models.
The methodology page describes a native meteorological grid of 0.5° × 0.625°, while some API examples describe a 0.5° output grid; distinguish source resolution from output sampling.

verification.scope: Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated.

coverage.temporal: ERA5 from 1940; ERA5-Land from 1950; IFS from 2017

variables: Layered soil temperature and moisture to 255 cm

access.note: The free noncommercial API requires no key and has usage limits; commercial and high-volume services have separate plans.

license.name: CC BY 4.0 for data; separate service terms
license.note: Distinguish the data licence from the noncommercial restriction on the free API service.

applications: Growing degree days and yield-model features
caveats: Use a fixed ERA5 or ERA5-Land configuration for long-term comparisons; Best Match combines sources.
Available variables differ by model; historical variables do not all have 9 km resolution.

verification.scope: Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated.

resources.name: SoilGrids 2.0
resources.summary: Machine-learning maps of soil properties and prediction uncertainty for baseline soil information.

coverage.temporal: Static spatial predictions; not an annual time series
coverage.spatial_resolution: 250 m; six standard depth intervals within 0–200 cm

access.note: Maps and files are public. The documentation currently reports a paused REST API; consider WCS or WebDAV.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.note: Cite the SoilGrids version and methodology paper.
